## 1. What we are asking you to do
You will wear a consumer EEG headset (it measures electrical activity at the scalp; it does not send anything into your body) and imagine squeezing your left or right hand when arrows appear on a screen. A session takes about 45 minutes. `TODO(counsel)`: risks (skin irritation, fatigue, rare seizure risk from visual stimuli) and exclusions.

## 2. What we record
- EEG signals during the tasks, and the time and direction of each arrow.
- Answers to a short questionnaire (handedness, age band, prior experience).
- **Not** recorded: your name in any data file. Data files carry a code (for example P014). Only authorized staff can link the code to you, using a separate, access-restricted list.

## 3. What you can agree to (each is separate and optional)
Tick each box you agree to. Saying no to any box has no effect on your compensation.

- [ ] **Product use during my session.** Use my signals live to calibrate and run the decoder while I am here. Nothing is kept after the session unless I also tick the next box.
- [ ] **Research.** Store my recordings securely and use them for internal research and evaluation of our software.
- [ ] **Commercial model training.** Use my recordings to train models that may be sold or licensed to other companies. Models do not contain my recordings, but they are shaped by them.

## 4. Your rights
- You can withdraw any agreement at any time, without giving a reason, by contacting `TODO(contact)`. We then delete your recordings. `TODO(counsel)`: what happens to models already trained, and the time frame for deletion.
- You can ask for a copy of your data, or for it to be corrected or deleted.
- We will never sell your raw neural data, never use it to identify you, and never use it to infer your health, emotions or other sensitive traits.
- `TODO(counsel)`: data retention period, storage location, transfers, and the lawful basis per jurisdiction.
